description.zh:
是否获取内网连接配置。取值：
- `true`：仅获取内网连接的KubeConfig凭证。
- `false`：仅获取公网连接的KubeConfig凭证。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to obtain the internal network connection configuration. Valid values:

- `true`: Obtains only the KubeConfig credentials for internal network connections.
- `false`: Obtains only the KubeConfig credentials for public network connections.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh:
临时KubeConfig有效期，单位：分钟。

取值范围：[15, 4320]，即最长3天。
> 当不设置该参数时，将由系统自动确定一个更长的有效期，具体过期时间通过返回的expiration字段的值确定。
description.en:
The validity period of the temporary KubeConfig. Unit: minutes.

Valid values: [15, 4320], which is up to 3 days.
> If this parameter is not set, the system automatically determines a longer validity period. The specific expiration time is indicated by the value of the expiration field in the response.

description.zh: 阿里云账号内指定的RAM用户或RAM角色ID。
description.en: The ID of the specified Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role within the Alibaba Cloud account.

title.zh: 使用阿里云账号获取指定RAM用户或角色的集群KubeConfig
title.en: Obtain the cluster kubeConfig of a specified RAM user or role by using an Alibaba Cloud account

descriptions.zh: 该接口只允许被阿里云账号（主账号）调用。
descriptions.en: This operation can be called only by an Alibaba Cloud account.
